prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection in Sugar Land, heading east on the main road. The light had just turned green for me.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I saw a car coming from the left side, but I thought it was going to stop. It didn't.
Q: What part of your vehicle was struck?
A: The driver's side door, right where I was sitting. The impact pushed me toward the center console.
Q: Did you hit anything else during the collision?
A: My left knee hit the dashboard area. That's where the pain started.
Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle on your own?
A: I got out, but I had to hold onto the door. My knee wouldn't take my weight comfortably.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor because of swelling and limited movement.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. I'm using a brace when I walk, and stairs are difficult. I'm still waiting on an MRI appointment.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was following the traffic signals and I believe the other driver was at fault for not yielding.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
